The streaming service charges $140 per month. For the first half of the year (6 months), Aleena pays the initial amount: 6 × $140 = $840. For the second half of the year (6 months), she pays 10% less per month: $140 × 0.9 = $126 per month, so 6 × $126 = $756. The total paid by the end of the year is $840 + $756 = $1596.

Answer: 1596
